# Penny

> Penny is an AI teaching assistant for South African teachers. Capture marks by voice, generate report comments and parent messages, and export learner results to Excel.

## Pricing

- One plan: R29/month (everything included)
- 3-day free trial, no credit card required

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Penny does and why teachers use it.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Plans and pricing from R29/month.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about trial, billing, and features.
- [Privacy](/privacy): How Penny collects, uses, and protects data.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms governing use of Penny.
